defaults.description:
Defaults for new branches (`by run`, `by fan`); `permissions` also
applies to `send`, `fork`, `reincarnate` and `spawn`.

secrets.description:
Secrets a new branch's harness is given, by name: `"VAR"` reads the
variable VAR, `"@path"` a file. Never the value itself. Applied only
to isolated or sandboxed branches, which have a private home.

mcp.description: Stdio MCP servers for a new branch's harness: `NAME = "/absolute/command args"`.

remote.description: Where commands run: a Branchyard server instead of this machine.

notify.description:
Telling you when a branch needs you or ends, from `by watch` and a
waiting `by run`, `by fan`, `by send` or `by fork`.

title: Branchyard configuration
description: Defaults for `by`: branchyard.toml at a repository root, or ~/.config/branchyard/config.toml. The project file overrides the user file, BRANCHYARD_* variables override both, flags override everything. Never holds a secret's value. See docs/setup.md.

harness.description: Harness or profile ID, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

model.description: A model name, or a size alias (`small`, `medium`, `large`, `extra-large`).

auth.description:
The authentication method when the secrets allow several:
`api-key`, `oauth-token`, `auth-file`, `vertex-ai`.

budget_usd.description: Stop once the harness's own cost estimate exceeds this many dollars.

max_minutes.description: Interrupt a turn after this many minutes.

permissions.description:
How tool permission requests are answered: `ask` on the terminal,
or `yes` to allow each one. Unset: decided by whether a terminal is
attached.

isolated.description: A scrubbed environment and a private HOME for the harness.

check.description: The check a candidate must pass before merging, such as `cargo test`.

instructions.description: A file of standing instructions for the harness.

oneOf.description: Ask on the terminal for each request (`--ask`).
A local process in its own worktree (the default).

A microVM per turn; needs `[microsandbox]` and a build with the
`microsandbox` feature.

token_file.description: A file holding the bearer token, as `--token-file`.

repo.description: The repository's name on the server, as `--repo`.

Remote.description: A Branchyard server to run commands against.

config.description: The server configuration `by serve` reads when given no `--config`.

image.description: OCI image with the harness installed.

pass_env.description: Variables to copy into the sandbox, by name.

enabled.description: Notify at all. Unset: yes; `--no-notify` turns it off for one command.

desktop.description:
Also show a desktop notification through `notify-send` (Linux and
other Unix) or `osascript` (macOS). Unset: no.

terminal.description: What to write to the terminal. Unset: `auto`.

Notify.description:
`[notify]`: when a branch asks for permission or asks a question,
stalls, fails, is interrupted or finishes.

oneOf.description:
A bell, and the desktop-notification escape this terminal is known
to take: OSC 777 on foot, urxvt and VTE terminals, OSC 9 elsewhere.
A bell and OSC 9 (iTerm2, WezTerm, kitty, Ghostty, Windows Terminal).
A bell and OSC 777 (foot, urxvt, VTE terminals such as GNOME Terminal, WezTerm).
Nothing on the terminal (the desktop notification, if on, still runs).

NotifyTerminal.description: The terminal side of a notification.
